teaser: If you are looking for a job you have time: act as the person in the job you want, in public, and give the people who want to help you a link.
core_idea: Someone looking for a job has time, and the best use of it is to do the job they want before they have it, for a startup, open-source project or company, in public so it can be linked; reach does not matter, because the link lets the people who want to help forward it, which is also why a CV should be online and why the small skill of publishing with an agent is worth learning first.

figures.caption: Act as the job you want. If you are looking for a job, you have time. Pick the job you want and act as that person: for a startup, an open-source project or a company you admire, add value, send ideas, tag them and connect with their people. Do it in public, so the work can be linked. Then the people who want to help you can forward it, and the work turns into references, paid work, introductions and, in time, the job.
